forecast.reinvestment_rationale: CapEx starts at 2.61% of revenue from the recency-weighted 3-year audited level (latest year 2.42%, simple average 2.66%) and fades to a 5.78% steady state by year 10, where net reinvestment equals 3.00% terminal growth / 30.0% return on new capital (base roic capped) = 10.0% of NOPAT; D&A is held at 2.93% (reported); working capital at -7.24% of incremental revenue (working_capital_days); SBC at 2.99% of revenue is already expensed in EBIT, so UFCF treats it as a cash cost.
